title: Cargo.lock is v4; the MSRV 1.75 CI job cannot parse it
description:
Cargo.lock line 3 is 'version = 4'. Lockfile v4 was stabilized in Rust 1.78. The MSRV job in .github/workflows/ci.yml installs dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.75 and runs 'cargo build'; Cargo 1.75 rejects a v4 lockfile outright ('lock file version 4 requires -Znext-lockfile-bump') before compiling anything.

Consequence: the MSRV job either fails on every run or has never actually validated MSRV. The declared rust-version = 1.75 in the root Cargo.toml is unverified.

Either downgrade the lockfile to v3 and keep 1.75, or raise the declared MSRV to >= 1.78 and update the CI toolchain to match.
close_reason: Fixed and verified. See commit 7c013e3. .3 closed separately: x509-cert bumped to 0.3.0; deletion recommendation retained in its notes.
